title: An apple a day - no problem
text: An apple a day - no problem. I really like apples but stop eating them because of their tough skins.  A neighbor introduced me to the apple slicer-core remover and now I eat an apple a day.  After you press the device down over the apple you have nice sized apple slices which have the skin on but because of the size of the slice, its easy to get the skin off.  If you have never used one you are in for a great experience.  Also, I am "older" and my strength in my hands isn't great and its still no problem to use this device. Sept. 20, 2020, ordered in July 2020, it broke in half today.
